summary.text:
Renewing the African American Civil Rights Network Act
This bill reauthorizes for seven years the African American Civil Rights Network. The network is a National Park Service (NPS) program that designates historical sites and educational resources that are connected to the African American civil rights movement from 1939 to 1968. The program expired on January 8, 2025.
Locations, facilities, and resources included in the network are eligible to use the network logo and receive technical support from the NPS.

title: Renewing the African American Civil Rights Network Act
